//: Config for the duplicate-code scan in .github/workflows/quality.yml.
Before this file existed, jscpd ran against everything and its single
biggest reported clone was pnpm-lock.yaml against itself: 268 lines of a
generated lockfile. Generated and vendored files inflate the number
without ever being something anyone would refactor, and the workflow
gates on a ratchet against the base branch, so noise in the denominator
makes real regressions harder to see rather than easier.
Everything excluded here is either generated, vendored, or a coverage
artifact. Real source duplication is deliberately still counted,
including the pre-existing kind: see the ROADMAP note on the CSV-import
dialogs for what is known and deliberately not refactored.
